items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-15
items.q: Well, he's a swell guy as long as he's not drinking.

ctx.x: I don't think he's doing much playing at night time. Manuel's a fellow that, uh, he's a pastor or a carpenter or something like that.

I don't think he's doing much playing at night time. Manuel's a fellow that, uh, he's a nice musician and he plays a lot. He knows a lot of instruments. I mean he knows a lot of trumpet, he knows a lot of sax, and he knows a lot of clarinet. Well, he's a swell guy as long as he's not drinking. But if he get to drinking, he'll have to walk off to the Roosevelt Hotel and leave you there. On and all, he'll leave it. He get to drinking. That mind hit him. He jumped right about that chair and walked straight on out…
He can drink anything you drink, but he just gets to rambling mind or something.
